spec.assertion: Baseline totals identical to a cocoa-with-empty-slots control, AND no 'heal'-introduced buffApply. Fails under the nearest-wrong where cover restore is encoded as a `heal` effect to all allies — that emits recovery events which fire crown's on-recovery consumer and shifts team totals (proven live by the healWrong run diverging from baseline). Cover HP is the cover pool, not the unit; no primitive models it.

it.skip — no debuff-cleanse primitive exists in the effect schema, and the scope-lock fight applies no ally debuff to remove. Covered indirectly by the whole-slot inertness assertion (emptying skill1 changes nothing).

No boss-held damageTakenPct buffApply (casterIdx===null AND targetIdx===null) originates from cocoa beyond what the stripped control emits, and baseline team sum < the boss-debuff-wrong run. Fails under the nearest-wrong that maps self-mitigation onto the schema's `damageTakenPct`, which inverts BOTH sign and target (positive = boss takes MORE) and would grant the team up to +65.55 damage-up at 15 stacks. Also asserts the full-charge trigger carries no offensive stat.
it.skip — same missing primitive as the skill1 cleanse. Covered by the burst-slot inertness assertion.

Emptying the burst slot leaves every unit's total byte-identical. Enemy ATK reduction acts on boss offense, which v1 does not model (immortal boss dealing no damage), so there is no observable payload. Fails only if the burst slot were given an offensive payload it does not have.

totals(stripped) deep-equals totals(baseline) — the entire kit is damage-inert. Backed by an offensive-stat diff over buffApply events (catches an offensive buff that is numerically inert today but would activate once a consumer lands), and by three non-vacuity guards: cocoa deals damage, fullBurstStart > 0 (cocoa is Burst I — helm supplies the B3, else zero Full Bursts make burst assertions vacuous), and the fixture demonstrably moves under an injected offensive effect.

fixtures: controlComp('cocoa', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / cocoa / helm B3. helm=true is REQUIRED: cocoa is Burst I, so without a Burst III the team makes zero Full Bursts and every burst-slot assertion is vacuous. crown's presence is load-bearing for the mis-encoded-heal counterfactual (her on-recovery trigger is what converts a wrong `heal` into visible damage). 4 hoisted 180s runs: baseline, all-slots-stripped control, heal-wrong, boss-debuff-wrong; plus one burst-only-stripped run inside its describe.
